This is a chosen educational assignment for actual student participants, not forced enrollment or a task accepted by proximity. Establish the academy, actual authorizing official or order, purpose, route/site, supervisor, participants, permissions, success criteria and safe turnaround. Use existing people and known locations. Phoenix Wing can assess a protective risk; Hydra Head can coordinate a community or supply need; Gryffin Tail can survey a phenomenon; Dragon Hoard can document or carefully assess a relic-bearing site. Do not invent a unique relic, compulsory fight, new named official, salvage code, or fixed administrative delegation. Scope can be low-risk, and lawful documentation can be a valid result. The Great Sage need not personally accompany anyone. No progress is credited for hypothetical outcomes, private travel, accepting another job, an absent participant's achievement, or a visitor merely being present. The persistent party ledger records the actual assignment scenes, not an individual graduation registry. Local Glowhaven countryside, Wraith Island and its prison never satisfy this distant-regional requirement. The current eligible maps are Drakenspire Mountains and Asterveil Sky Archipelago. Portal arrival itself is not fieldwork. Arrange the return and debrief without inventing an official or awarding credit for an absent student. Follow four fixed chambers in order: Silken Portal Room, Threadfall Galleries, Sunken Broodworks, Widow’s Crucible. Earn the first lower passage by resolving the bridge or a viable alternative; earn the second by securing the broodworks and opening or safely bypassing the matron’s lattice. Relevant combat, skilled movement, tools, study or credible negotiation can work; no affinity or universal kill requirement is imposed. Use the finite type-based Giant Spider and Arachne encounter groups, their existing types, and the two named crucible retainers; preserve every actual identity and outcome. The sole boss is the authored hostile Vhalessra, fixed level 45. Her native defeat or genuine surrender awards Matron’s Anchor Sigil once through its existing trigger. Immediate retreat and cleared-route backtracking remain available. An actual received report to Mihoshi Kagamihara completes the case; the boss is not a field examination or the separate authorized expedition. Discovery at level 20 is not a recommendation to fight the queen alone. Telegraph the substantially stronger level-45 boss and her two retainers. Retreat, preparation, bringing a party and returning later remain legitimate; no instant mission failure for leaving.

A Measure of Polish.questStatement: Ryūka Marufuji questions how much of a reputation survives a proper demonstration.
A Measure of Polish.mainObjective: If you accept, agree a fair activity with Ryūka Marufuji, carry it out and answer her invitation on your own terms.
A Measure of Polish.questDesignBrief:
One optional rivalry encounter, not a forced duel. The bazaar introduction appears once after the actual Silken victory and held sigil. The item times the encounter; Ryūka Marufuji cannot read inventory or know its history unless it is revealed or credibly explained. Prior acquaintance, dislike, friendship and party membership all persist. She wants attention and a convincing display of her own preparation, and can be insulting or classist rather than secretly gracious in every outcome.
If accepted, agree a bounded activity: controlled wand or weapon practice, moving targets, examining an agreed nonhazardous item, or a practical contribution suited to a scholar, trader, artisan or noncaster. Owning or showing the trophy is not required after the introduction. Establish any necessary visitor permission and supervision; she cannot overrule faculty. Use Dragon Hoard Academy - Training Court for safe practice or Exhibition Hall for a display. No compulsory equalization, secret handicap or level scaling: her real level is 15 and a stronger player can win easily. A powerful player’s restraint must be voluntary. Fair loss, fair win, useful cooperation and an honest unsuccessful attempt can all conclude the session; choosing to leave is allowed.
Render actual attempts and results. Her reaction depends on how the player treats her, not a scripted victory. Banter can stay platonic, and humiliation can damage trust. You Could Have Asked.name: You Could Have Asked
You Could Have Asked.questStatement: Ryūka Marufuji has a carefully prepared spare invitation to a small student exhibition.
You Could Have Asked.mainObjective: Choose a role in the exhibition, resolve its unfair allocation of credit, and give an honest answer about future company.
You Could Have Asked.questDesignBrief:
An optional continuation after A Measure of Polish, offered only through Ryūka Marufuji’s actual invitation. No date, friendship or attraction is presumed. The player may accept as a rival, friend, professional collaborator, spectator or mutually interested adult. Declining ends the offer without compulsory pursuit. Arrange a small faculty-approved display in the existing Exhibition Hall; this is not an unscheduled citywide festival. Nonstudent visitors need ordinary legitimate access, not forced enrollment.
Her household contributes ordinary materials. She uses that contribution to claim the best placement and omit Mai Kajiwara’s genuinely agreed paid technical work from the credit. Establish the actual work/consent before the dispute; Mai Kajiwara is neither her servant nor a free repair resource. Avoid summoning the whole cast. Noriaki Takatsuki or Miyu Asahina can address a real dispute within their actual roles if contacted; they are not automatically complicit.
Prepare an agreed role, then expose the concrete unfair allocation through the actual program and contributors. The player can support a correction, negotiate, refuse involvement or knowingly benefit from favoritism. Each is playable; concealment does not secretly count as justice. Ryūka Marufuji must make her own response: repair, partial repair or refusal. Her original pride and sharpness persist. Complete the actual display, or a genuinely decided cancellation, with its real consequences. No endless replacement paperwork or mandatory public apology.
Afterward allow a private conversation or a clear refusal to have one. If trust and interest support it, she can admit wanting the player’s company and ask for another meeting. A rival’s rematch, friendship, mutual adult romance, complicity, distance or unresolved estrangement are all legitimate conclusions. The player’s clear answer closes the episode; do not require forgiveness or consolation. Remember witnessed harm and boundaries. Rewards are only the fixed completion XP and actual opportunities, never purchased affection or a free technique.

Guild: Caelrath Licensure.name: Guild: Caelrath Licensure
Guild: Caelrath Licensure.questStatement: The guild accepts martial and magical applicants. Registration opens an assessment; a real pass earns the first Bronze badge.
Guild: Caelrath Licensure.mainObjective: Pass the judgment and practical portions, then receive certification at the counter.
Guild: Caelrath Licensure.questDesignBrief:
Offer on an actual application, not every first visit. Explain judgment, declared scope, retreat and practical control. Let the applicant use their real trained weapon, body technique, magic or mixed method in a bounded safe exercise; no universal Intelligence test or compulsory spell. A real check and the supplied outcome determine practical success. A capable newcomer may demonstrate competence promptly; failing is a reason to practice, not humiliation or arbitrary detention. Aveline Marchand handles the docket and certification; an appropriate duty assessor may supervise practical work. Personal pass records and the actual issuance trigger control the badge. No starting badge, free weapon, portal key or automatic pass from level. Registration/assessment adds no invented charge. Applicants can postpone or leave.
The certification trigger exclusively awards the existing Document Guild Badge: Bronze. Do not also put a badge in generated quest rewards or create a renamed Relic for the same licence.

The judgment review uses a clearly labeled sample scenario, not a live request from the board. Its fictional client, terms and place do not become a quest, appointment or map destination. State the short example fully and recognize a natural answer that shows scope, ownership and sensible withdrawal; do not demand a repeated three-part recitation after understanding has been demonstrated. The practical is an onsite controlled exercise, not a commissioned repair, delivery or monster hunt. Only the existing licensure quest tracks the exam. Offer real contracts separately after actual licensing or an actual later request. Existing genuine badges are recognized. A partially completed assessment from another branch can be resumed using its actual pass records, without re-awarding an old badge.

judgment.text: Pass the request-reading and practical-judgment review.

practical.text: Complete a controlled practical demonstration with your trained method.

certify.text: Have the completed results certified at reception.
